title: REQ · Send is disabled and submit is blocked when remaining quota is 0
summary: Send button disabled and submit guarded at zero quota
description: Context: handleSubmit (L71-93) only guards blank and over-limit. Desired behavior: at remaining 0 the Send button is disabled and handleSubmit returns before calling submitContribution. Expected result: no request is made past the quota. Why: prevents wasted requests and 409 errors.
acceptance_criteria: Given remaining is 0 When the sheet renders Then the Send button has the disabled attribute
Given remaining is 0 When the form is submitted programmatically Then submitContribution is not called and no entry is added
Given remaining is 1 When valid text is submitted Then submitContribution is called once
technical_constraints: Guard must work even if the button is bypassed via form submit event
definition_of_done: Send disabled and submit blocked at zero quota
